Admin Panel.desc: Grants access to the Admin Panel.

Streamer Polls.desc: Survive against the choices of viewers.

So Much Variety.desc: Angler is removed from the roster.

Sneak Attack.desc: Nodes can spawn from the front.

Hunted.desc: Listen for strong wind noises, adds Pipsqueak to the roster.

GOM.desc: When the blue timer hits zero, hide in a locker, else lose HP.

Tight Security.desc: Keycards no longer spawn, locked doors require a passcode.

Light Work.desc: Listen for audio cues, rooms may be less lit.

Forgot To Pay The Bills.desc: Rely heavily on audio cues, all rooms are dark.

Closed For The Night.desc: The vent in Sebastian's room never opens, barring access to his shop. His room will not be locked.

Paranoia.desc: Lockers will kick you out earlier, time your hiding.

Natural Resistance.desc: All healing from items is halved.

Good People Don't End Up Here.desc: Fake doors no longer emit visual cues, listen for breathing. Good People chances are increased.

One Time Use.desc: Upon exiting a locker, it will delete itself.

Turret Upgrades.desc: Turret lights will remain off, watch for where it's looking.

Free Trial.desc: Find a good hiding spot, when the timer hits zero, you will be forced to watch an unskippable advertisement.
